title: After Valentine's
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, quiet old American town in late winter, rain-slick brick streets and gaslight-style lamps, vintage cream envelopes with red wax seals and dried roses, faded rose and slate blue tones, adults only, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Final part. The letters were never late. 💌

Original fiction. Season 2 coming soon.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: on Valentine's night, Ben drove Thomas to the old mill bridge. In the mirror, the passenger seat was empty.
scenes.image: a car parked at the end of an old stone bridge in the rain at night

scenes.narration: Thomas was there when Ben looked again. Smiling. Look, he said. She came.
scenes.image: an old man in a camel coat stepping out of a car, gazing toward a bridge

scenes.narration: A woman in a red coat stood at the center of the bridge. White hair. Seventy-something. Holding an umbrella.
scenes.image: an elderly woman in a red coat with an umbrella standing alone on a stone bridge under a lamp

scenes.narration: Ben walked up to her. She looked right past Thomas, straight at Ben, and said: you're the mail carrier, aren't you.
scenes.image: an elderly woman in a red coat looking at a mail carrier, rain falling between them

scenes.narration: I mailed those letters in February, 1975. Every day. He never answered. Because on Valentine's night, driving here in the ice storm, Thomas went off this bridge.
scenes.image: an old stone bridge railing in the rain, a gap in the stones repaired long ago

scenes.narration: The letters were never late. He was. And for fifty-two years, his house has been waiting for its mail.
scenes.image: a boarded-up house at night with a lamp glowing in the upstairs window

scenes.narration: Ben turned. Thomas stood beside her now. He didn't look eighty anymore. He looked twenty-eight, soaking wet, holding a ring box.
scenes.image: a young man in a soaked camel coat holding an open ring box on a rainy bridge

scenes.narration: He kissed her cheek. She couldn't see him. But she closed her eyes, and touched her face, and smiled.
scenes.image: an elderly woman with eyes closed and a hand on her cheek, a faint young man beside her in the rain

scenes.narration: Then the rain stopped. The bridge was empty. And Ben's mailbag has been light ever since.
scenes.image: an empty stone bridge after the rain, a single red rose petal on the wet stones

scenes.narration: Some mail just takes the long way home. Midnight Files will be back. Season 2 is coming.
scenes.image: a lone mail carrier walking away down a misty street at dawn, a lamp glowing ahead
